scope: Representative primary-source signals for model systems, agent runtimes, protocols and inference infrastructure. Not a ranking and not exhaustive.

items.name: GPT-6 Astra
facts: OpenAI positions Astra as a frontier model for computer use, browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, science and professional work.
The public release description attributes capability to pre-training, reinforcement learning and alignment rather than disclosing a complete architecture recipe.
items.evidence_boundary: Do not infer undisclosed parameter count, layer topology, MoE structure or training recipe.

items.name: OpenAI Agents API
facts: OpenAI describes the service as the Codex harness and infrastructure exposed through an API.
The public description emphasizes context management, tool use, subagent coordination, long-running execution, files, code and saved intermediate results.
items.evidence_boundary: A hosted product description does not expose every production scheduler, persistence or safety implementation detail.

items.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
facts: New Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture with 8B active parameters for input and 16B for output.
DeepSeek reports KV cache requirements of one quarter the HBM and one eighth the SSD storage of the previous generation.
The release explicitly credits new pretraining methods and larger-scale RL post-training, and includes native visual understanding.
items.evidence_boundary: Vendor benchmark claims remain vendor-reported until independently reproduced.

items.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash built-in computer use
facts: Google integrated computer use as a built-in tool in the main Gemini 3.5 Flash model rather than keeping it only as a separate computer-use model.
The official description targets browser, mobile and desktop environments and long-horizon enterprise automation.
items.evidence_boundary: Product-level capability does not reveal the complete visual grounding, action policy or safety implementation.

items.name: Model Context Protocol 2026-07-28
facts: The core protocol became stateless request/response and retired the required initialize/initialized session handshake.
The release added server/discover, header-based routing, cache hints for list results, authorization hardening and a formal extensions framework.
Tasks moved to an extension for long-running work.
items.evidence_boundary: Implementations targeting older 2025 lifecycle/session semantics must not be described as 2026-07-28 compliant.

items.name: Agent2Agent Protocol 1.0.0
facts: A2A 1.0.0 defines a vendor- and framework-independent data model for agent discovery, messages, tasks, artifacts and interoperability.
The 1.0 specification separates abstract operations from concrete protocol bindings such as JSON-RPC, gRPC and HTTP/REST.
items.evidence_boundary: A2A defines interoperability semantics; it is not a planner, memory system or agent policy.

items.name: vLLM serving feature set
facts: Current vLLM documents PagedAttention, continuous batching, chunked prefill and prefix caching as core serving features.
It also documents speculative decoding, multiple optimized attention kernels, distributed tensor/pipeline/data/expert/context parallelism and disaggregated prefill/decode.
items.evidence_boundary: Feature presence does not imply every backend/model combination has identical maturity or performance.
